title: Yesterday I had such and crazy mall world dream lol (TW:Car accident / sex)
content: I was driving in a car with like 4 other people, we were going back to the dorm hotel, and we had been drinking and doing drugs? Anyway one girl was saying something mean to me, and she opened the door to get out, the uber didn't come to a stop, causing her to hit her head falling out and die. I was screaming to the crowd in the giant parking lot to call 911 bc my phone wasn't working. By the time the ambulance came it was too late. My phone was shut off due to being in witness protection for witnessing a crime. I went back into the dorm hotel and was trying to call my partner to tell her where I was but I couldn't because my phone wasn't working. Everyone was gossiping about what happened, and a bunch of people were congregating in an outside room in an auditorium because cops were coming to do investigations so people who sell drugs were like trying to figure out how to hide them etc. I decided to walk into the auditorium to see what was going on and then left. I was going to head back to the elevator when everyone started panicking to get to the upper levels of the hotel. Someone grabbed my arm to look at my watch to see the time and then pressed the elevator buttons frantically in the correct secret order to get to the correct floor, but I didn't know why (I think this was my brain processing watching 3 body problem a few weeks ago because it was like the countdown the scientists were seeing). I finally realized what was happening but it was too late so I didn't get in the elevator in time. I was walking around freaking out about what this might mean for me, when i found out that the auditorium scenero was set up to trap all of the people the cops wanted punished so they couldn't get to the elevator in time, and by entering that room, my name got added to the list so I had unknowingly sealed my fate. I saw my ex and was like ok well I'll just have sex with him (which I often control in my dreams lol- and i know the reason is bc im bi, in a WLW LTR and if im being honest, miss the feeling of a warm dick lmao). However this time during that he transformed into an anime looking demon? And told me that since I didn't get to the elevator in time, now I'm cursed to be susceptible to succubi/incubi. The incubus would do things to tempt me into interacting with them and would mask themselves to be other people to trick me, and whenever I would interact with the incubus or think about sex with them, the surroundings would start to shake because it was going to cause some catastrophic event.There were also random students who were secretly demon hunters who would shoot them with an arrow while they were pretending to be other people to reveal their true form. I think by the end of the dream I didn't even care any more because I was like lucid at that point and wanted dream set but the whole thing was WILD.
